headline: OR Cleaning Crew · Master
threshold: Communicate during OR cleaning shifts in Spanish, ask for clarification and confirm room readiness.

lessons.title: Explain Top-to-Bottom, Clean-to-Dirty to a New Hire
lessons.objective: Handle explain top-to-bottom, clean-to-dirty to a new hire in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss explain top-to-bottom, clean-to-dirty to a new hire with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain and demonstrate. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: la cubeta de desechos con ruedas
Primero limpiamos arriba y luego vamos bajando.
words.en: First we clean up high, then we work our way down.

words.es: Trapeamos al final porque el polvo y las gotas caen desde arriba.
words.en: We mop last because dust and drips fall from above.

words.es: Vamos de lo limpio a lo sucio para no propagar gérmenes.
words.en: We go from clean to dirty, so we don't spread germs.

words.es: Empieza por la lámpara quirúrgica y luego sigue con el brazo articulado.
words.en: Start with the surgical light, then do the boom.

words.es: El piso espera, porque todo lo demás gotea sobre él.
words.en: The floor waits, because everything else drips onto it.

words.es: Bueno, Devon, ahora explícame tú el orden.
words.en: Okay, Devon, now explain the order back to me.

words.es: Enfermera, ¿puedo capacitar a nuestro técnico nuevo en el quirófano 4 ahora?
words.en: Nurse, may I train our new tech in OR 4 now?

grammar.focus: Explain and demonstrate: Formal usted commands: revise, limpie, confirme; negative: no entre. Pronoun placement changes with negative commands.

examples.es: Revise la etiqueta y confirme el tiempo de contacto.
examples.en: Check the label and confirm the contact time.

examples.es: No entre hasta que la enfermera confirme que puede pasar.
examples.en: Do not enter until the nurse confirms that you may come in.

lessons.title: Why the Surface Has to Stay Wet: Dwell Time
lessons.objective: Handle why the surface has to stay wet: dwell time in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss why the surface has to stay wet: dwell time with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain and demonstrate. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: Espera, Kenji, no lo seques todavía.
words.en: Hold on, Kenji, don't dry it off yet.

words.es: La superficie tiene que quedar húmeda durante todo el tiempo de contacto.
words.en: The surface has to stay wet for the whole contact time.

words.es: Si se seca demasiado pronto, no queda desinfectada.
words.en: If it dries too early, it isn't disinfected.

words.es: El tiempo de contacto está impreso en la etiqueta, aquí mismo.
words.en: The contact time is printed on the label, right here.

words.es: Si se seca antes del tiempo de la etiqueta, vuelve a pasarle la toallita.
words.en: If it dries before the label's time, wipe it again.

words.es: Entonces, ¿qué pasa si la mesa de Mayo se seca muy rápido?
words.en: So, what happens if the Mayo stand dries too fast?

words.es: Cada producto es diferente, así que siempre leemos la etiqueta primero.
words.en: Every product is different, so we always read the label first.

words.es: Enfermera, la mesa de Mayo estará lista en unos minutos.
words.en: Nurse, the Mayo stand will be ready in a few minutes.

lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss training a new tech on canisters and sharps swaps with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain and demonstrate. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: ¡Amara, detente, no lo empujes hacia abajo!
words.en: Amara, stop, don't push it down!

words.es: Ciérralo cuando llegue a la línea de llenado.
words.en: Close it when it hits the fill line.

words.es: Levántalo por el asa y mantenlo lejos de tu cuerpo.
words.en: Lift it by the handle and keep it away from you.
Never put your hand inside it.

words.es: Primero tapa los dos puertos y luego saca el recipiente.
words.en: Cap both ports first, then lift the canister out.

words.es: Ciérralo bien y luego ponlo en el carrito.
words.en: Lock it shut, and then set it on the cart.

words.es: Bien, ahora muéstrame cómo lo harías tú.
words.en: Good, now show me how you'd do it.

words.es: Disculpe, ¿podemos cambiar el contenedor de objetos punzocortantes ahora?
words.en: Excuse me, may we change the sharps container now?

words.es: la estación de lavado de ojos
el número de registro de la EPA
Antes de abrirlo, revisa la sección de EPP en la etiqueta.
words.en: Before opening it, check the PPE section on the label.

words.es: La etiqueta nueva dice que el tiempo de contacto es de 3 minutos.
words.en: The new label says the contact time is 3 minutes.

words.es: Después de limpiar, tienes que dejarlo húmedo durante ese tiempo.
words.en: After wiping, you have to leave it wet for that time.

words.es: La hoja de datos de seguridad dice que debemos usar gafas protectoras con este.
words.en: The SDS says we must wear goggles with this one.

words.es: Gloria, ¿puedes leer en voz alta la sección de primeros auxilios?
words.en: Gloria, can you read the first-aid section out loud?

words.es: Si algo no está claro, paramos y le preguntamos al supervisor.
words.en: If anything is unclear, we stop and ask the supervisor.

words.es: Disculpe, ¿dónde está la carpeta de hojas de seguridad del producto nuevo?
words.en: Excuse me, where is the SDS binder for the new product?

lessons.title: Blood Found Under the Table Base After Room Ready
lessons.objective: Handle blood found under the table base after room ready in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss blood found under the table base after room ready with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain and demonstrate. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: el punto que se pasó por alto
Lo siento, se me pasó ese punto, y es mi responsabilidad.
words.en: I'm sorry, I missed that spot, and that's on me.

words.es: Estaba trapeando cuando me llamaron al quirófano 6.
words.en: I was mopping when they called me to OR 6.

words.es: No revisé los huecos de las ruedas con una linterna.
words.en: I didn't check the caster wells with a flashlight.

words.es: Primero quitaría la sangre y luego desinfectaría toda la base.
words.en: I would pre-clean the blood first, then disinfect the whole base.

words.es: Sr. Saleh, asumo toda la responsabilidad por el punto que se me pasó.
words.en: Mr. Saleh, I take full responsibility for the missed spot.

words.es: Rachel, ¿puedes detener la sala mientras la vuelvo a limpiar?
words.en: Rachel, can you hold the room while I re-clean it?

words.es: De ahora en adelante, revisaré las ruedas con una linterna.
words.en: From now on, I'll check the casters with a flashlight.

lessons.title: Out of Wipes: The Approved Substitute Takes Longer
lessons.objective: Handle out of wipes: the approved substitute takes longer in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss out of wipes: the approved substitute takes longer with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain reasons and conditions. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: el tiempo de recambio de sala
Se nos acabaron las toallitas de siempre.
words.en: We just ran out of our usual wipes.

words.es: Linda aprobó un sustituto, así que lo estamos usando ahora.
words.en: Linda approved a substitute, so we're using it now.

words.es: Este producto necesita más tiempo de contacto que nuestras toallitas, según la etiqueta.
words.en: This product needs more contact time than our wipes, per the label.

words.es: La sala va a estar lista más tarde de lo previsto.
words.en: The room is going to be ready later than planned.

words.es: Owen, aviso: vamos a tardar unos 10 minutos más.
words.en: Owen, heads-up: we're going to be about 10 minutes late.

words.es: Le aviso en cuanto esté lista.
words.en: I'll let you know the moment it's ready.

words.es: El spray es más lento que las toallitas, pero está aprobado.
words.en: The spray is slower than the wipes, but it's approved.

words.es: ¿Quiere que le avise yo a anestesia, o lo hace usted?
words.en: Would you like me to update anesthesia, or will you?

examples.en: It is important that the surface remain wet.

examples.es: Necesito que me explique la instrucción.
examples.en: I need you to explain the instruction to me.

lessons.title: Ceiling Dust from a Contractor in a Clean Room
lessons.objective: Handle ceiling dust from a contractor in a clean room in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss ceiling dust from a contractor in a clean room with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain reasons and conditions. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: el equipo de mantenimiento de instalaciones
el equipo de control de infecciones
Señor, por favor deténgase y cierre el panel ahora mismo.
words.en: Sir, please stop and close the panel right now.

words.es: Este quirófano está limpio, así que no se puede abrir el techo aquí.
words.en: This OR is clean, so the ceiling can't be opened here.

words.es: ¿Tiene un permiso ICRA para esta sala?
words.en: Do you have an ICRA permit for this room?

words.es: Abrió la placa del techo a las 6:40, justo encima de la mesa.
words.en: He opened the ceiling tile at 6:40, right above the table.

words.es: Lo detuve a las 6:42 y la cerró.
words.en: I stopped him at 6:42, and he closed it.

words.es: Cayó polvo sobre la mesa y el mostrador del fondo en el quirófano 5.
words.en: Dust fell on the table and the back counter in OR 5.

words.es: Priya, nadie entró al quirófano 5 después de que lo cerré con llave.
words.en: Priya, nobody entered OR 5 after I locked it.

words.es: ¿Llamo yo a control de infecciones, o lo hace usted?
words.en: Should I call infection control, or will you?

lessons.title: Saying No: The Surgeon Wants the Patient In Now
lessons.objective: Handle saying no: the surgeon wants the patient in now in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss saying no: the surgeon wants the patient in now with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain reasons and conditions. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: Por favor, no traigan al paciente todavía.
words.en: Please don't bring the patient in yet.

words.es: Dra. Foster, la entiendo, pero el piso todavía está mojado.
words.en: Dr. Foster, I understand, but the floor is still wet.

words.es: No le recomiendo que meta la cama ahora.
words.en: I don't recommend that you wheel the bed in now.

words.es: Según la etiqueta, tiene que seguir mojado 4 minutos más.
words.en: Per the label, it has to stay wet 4 more minutes.

words.es: Por favor, no pisen ese lado hasta que esté seco.
words.en: Please don't step on that side until it's dry.

words.es: Puedo llamar a otro técnico para terminar las paredes más rápido.
words.en: I can call another tech to finish the walls faster.

words.es: Sam, ¿puedes dejar al paciente en el área de espera por ahora?
words.en: Sam, can you keep the patient in holding for now?

words.es: Si lo necesita, por favor consulte con la enfermera a cargo.
words.en: If you need to, please check with the charge nurse.

lessons.title: Feedback for a Tech Who Missed the Mayo Stand
lessons.objective: Handle feedback for a tech who missed the mayo stand in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss feedback for a tech who missed the mayo stand with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain reasons and conditions. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: Jordan, ¿tienes un minuto para hablar en privado?
words.en: Jordan, do you have a minute to talk in private?

words.es: Fatima notó que la parte de abajo de la mesa de Mayo seguía sucia.
words.en: Fatima noticed the underside of the Mayo stand was still dirty.

words.es: Deberías revisar la parte de abajo cada vez que limpias la mesa.
words.en: You should check the underside every time you wipe the stand.

words.es: Te sugiero seguir el cable del bovie hasta el pedal.
words.en: I suggest following the bovie cord all the way to the pedal.

words.es: Te recomiendo hacer una doble verificación antes de decir que la sala está lista.
words.en: I recommend doing a double-check before you call the room ready.

words.es: ¿Qué crees que pasó en la Sala B?
words.en: What do you think happened in Room B?

words.es: Mañana revisamos juntos la siguiente sala, ¿de acuerdo?
words.en: Let's check the next room together tomorrow, okay?

words.es: Sra. Rahman, gracias por avisarme; ya hablé con Jordan.
words.en: Ms. Rahman, thank you for telling me; I've spoken with Jordan.

lessons.title: Day and Evening Techs Argue Over a Half-Done Room
lessons.objective: Handle day and evening techs argue over a half-done room in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss day and evening techs argue over a half-done room with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and explain reasons and conditions. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: la regla de entrega de turno
Carla, Malik, hablemos de esto con calma en la sala de descanso.
words.en: Carla, Malik, let's talk about this calmly in the break room.

words.es: Uno a la vez, por favor; todos van a poder hablar.
words.en: One at a time, please; everyone gets a turn.

words.es: Carla dijo que había empezado la sala a las 2:30.
words.en: Carla said that she had started the room at 2:30.

words.es: Malik dijo que estaba cubriendo otro caso en el quirófano 9.
words.en: Malik said he was covering another case in OR 9.

words.es: ¿Entonces cada uno pensó que el otro lo iba a terminar?
words.en: So you both thought the other one would finish it?

words.es: Esto no se trata de culpas; se trata del próximo turno.
words.en: This isn't about blame; it's about the next shift.

words.es: De ahora en adelante, nadie se va sin una nota escrita de entrega.
words.en: From now on, nobody leaves without a written handoff note.
Does that sound fair to both of you?

lessons.title: Keeping a Short-Staffed Crew Going All Weekend
lessons.objective: Handle keeping a short-staffed crew going all weekend in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss keeping a short-staffed crew going all weekend with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and report, clarify and hand over. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: el aviso de ausencia por enfermedad
Yo me encargo de las próximas dos salas, así descansas.
words.en: I'll take the next two rooms, so you can rest.

words.es: Lo estás haciendo muy bien, y vamos a salir adelante juntos.
words.en: You're doing great, and we'll get through this together.

words.es: Rob, te entiendo; ha sido un día muy largo.
words.en: Rob, I hear you; it's been a really long day.

words.es: Voy a llamar a la oficina de personal para pedir el técnico de guardia.
words.en: I'll call staffing and ask for the on-call tech.

words.es: Ines, ¿te encargas del quirófano 3 mientras Keisha hace el 5?
words.en: Ines, will you take OR 3 while Keisha does OR 5?

words.es: Turnémonos, para que nadie haga todas las salas de trauma.
words.en: Let's take turns, so nobody does all the trauma rooms.

words.es: Tómate 10 minutos, toma agua y luego regresa.
words.en: Take 10 minutes, grab some water, and then come back.

words.es: Si de verdad necesitas irte, yo hablo con el supervisor.
words.en: If you really need to leave, I'll talk to the supervisor.

grammar.focus: Report, clarify and hand over: Use había + participle for an action completed before another past event. Contrast revisé with revisaba.

examples.es: Ya habíamos revisado la sala cuando llegó la supervisora.
examples.en: We had already checked the room when the supervisor arrived.

examples.es: Ya había terminado cuando llegó el equipo.
examples.en: I had already finished when the team arrived.

lessons.title: One Delay, Four Listeners: Surgeon to Family

words.es: la sala de espera de cirugía
Dr. Hahn, ¿podría darnos 5 minutos más para el quirófano 7?
words.en: Dr. Hahn, could you give us 5 more minutes for OR 7?

words.es: Nadia, necesitamos 5 minutos más en el quirófano 7.
words.en: Nadia, we need 5 more minutes in OR 7.

words.es: Leo, tranquilo, agarra el trapeador y sígueme.
words.en: Leo, no worries, grab the mop and follow me.

words.es: Señor, lo siento, pero no puedo dar información sobre pacientes.
words.en: Sir, I'm sorry, but I can't share information about patients.

words.es: ¿Le molestaría esperar aquí a la enfermera?
words.en: Would you mind waiting here for the nurse?

words.es: Le avisaré a la enfermera que usted está aquí.
words.en: I'll let the nurse know you're here.

words.es: ¿Quiere que lo acompañe a la sala de espera?
words.en: Would you like me to walk you to the waiting room?

examples.en: We had already checked the room when the supervisor arrived.

lessons.title: Needlestick in the Drapes: The Incident Report
lessons.objective: Handle needlestick in the drapes: the incident report in Spanish: exchange the relevant details, clarify an instruction and confirm the next step.
lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss needlestick in the drapes: the incident report with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and report, clarify and hand over. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: la oficina de salud del personal
Andre, lávalo con agua y jabón ahora mismo.
words.en: Andre, wash it with soap and water right now.

words.es: Megan, a Andre lo acaba de pinchar una aguja en una sábana quirúrgica.
words.en: Megan, Andre just got stuck by a needle in a drape.

words.es: A las 10:15, Andre levantó la sábana quirúrgica de la mesa de operaciones.
words.en: At 10:15, Andre lifted the drape off the OR table.

words.es: Justo después, sintió que la aguja atravesaba su guante.
words.en: Right after that, he felt the needle go through his glove.

words.es: Luego se lo lavó, y yo te llamé a las 10:18.
words.en: Then he washed it, and I called you at 10:18.

words.es: Deja la sábana ahí y no metas la mano.
words.en: Leave the drape there, and don't reach inside it.

words.es: Sra. Riley, ¿debe ir ahora a salud del personal, según la política?
words.en: Ms. Riley, should he go to employee health now, per policy?

words.es: ¿Alguien vio la aguja antes de que él levantara la sábana?
words.en: Did anyone see the needle before he lifted the drape?

examples.en: We had already checked the room when the supervisor arrived.

lessons.title: Near Miss: Two Cleaners Almost in One Bucket

lessons.speaking: You are an OR cleaning crew member. Discuss near miss: two cleaners almost in one bucket with your partner in Spanish. Use the lesson vocabulary and report, clarify and hand over. Ask for clarification, then confirm the plan.

words.es: ¡Sofía, para! Esa cubeta ya tiene un limpiador.
words.en: Sofia, stop! That bucket already has a cleaner in it.

words.es: Ella casi vertió el segundo producto en la misma cubeta.
words.en: She nearly poured the second product into the same bucket.

words.es: Podría haber producido un gas tóxico si lo hubiera vertido.
words.en: It could have made a toxic gas if she had poured it.

words.es: En ese cuarto tan pequeño, los vapores nos podrían haber hecho daño.
words.en: In that small room, the fumes could have hurt us.

words.es: Nadie está en problemas; solo queremos entender qué pasó.
words.en: Nobody is in trouble; we just want to understand what happened.

words.es: La cubeta no tenía etiqueta, así que casi los mezcló.
words.en: The bucket wasn't labeled, so she almost mixed them.

words.es: Darnell, ¿podemos etiquetar cada cubeta antes de llenarla?
words.en: Darnell, can we label every bucket before we fill it?

words.es: Gracias por detenerte, Sofía; lo detectaste a tiempo.
words.en: Thanks for stopping, Sofia; that was a good catch.

examples.en: We had already checked the room when the supervisor arrived.

words.es: la orden de detener el trabajo
¡Paren el trabajo! Nadie entra al cuarto subestéril.
words.en: Stop work! Nobody goes into the substerile room.

words.es: Joanne, tenemos un derrame de formol en el cuarto subestéril.
words.en: Joanne, we have a formalin spill in the substerile room.

words.es: Quédate afuera, cierra la puerta y llama al equipo de derrames.
words.en: Stay out, close the door, and call the spill team.

words.es: Si lo hueles, saldrás del área de inmediato.
